title: vary header can't be overwritten even defined explicitly in middleware

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue or a replay of the bug

https://github.com/yanv1991/cache-control/

### To Reproduce

- start application in prod mode.
- open browser devtools in the root page
- go to network tab and look for the html document at the very top level, click on it
- look for response headers (vary)



### Current vs. Expected behavior

current result:
- vary is not being set(overwritten), even when we set this in middleware file using dynamic rendering

![Screen Shot 2023-09-14 at 11 55 27 AM](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/assets/3800032/3757cc82-dde0-4e5d-9735-c7de7edd9426)

expected result 
- vary should be defined in response header according to the value set in middleware file

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: x64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 20.6.0: Thu Jul  6 22:12:47 PDT 2023; root:xnu-7195.141.49.702.12~1/RELEASE_X86_64
    Binaries:
      Node: 16.14.2
      npm: 8.5.0
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant Packages:
      next: 13.4.20-canary.28
      eslint-config-next: 13.4.19
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 5.2.2
    Next.js Config:
      output: N/A
```


### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

App Router

### Additional context

we need to define this vary to be passed to our cdn in order to cache effectively
